verdict.rationale: Contract-renewal monitoring through an API is a fair question for a legal-services platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows human-facing compliance features: email reminders via the Compliance Calendar, annual-report deadline alerts and a dashboard. None of these is a documented public API an agent could use to monitor contract renewals and act on them. The llms.txt file is crawler guidance, not a programmatic interface, so it earns no credit.
